config.enableLogging.name: Enable logging
config.enableLogging.tooltip: OFF (default): no debug output; warnings and errors are always logged. ON: full debug logging (for troubleshooting).
config.randomFishBehavior.name: Fully random fish behavior (harder)
config.randomFishBehavior.tooltip: OFF (default): the same fish at the same level behaves identically until caught, so you can learn its pattern. ON: every attempt is completely random and never fixed - much harder.
config.festivalFishing.name: Apply mod rules to fishing festivals
config.festivalFishing.tooltip: OFF (default): fishing at the SquidFest, Trout Derby and Festival of Ice is completely vanilla (the fish aren't keeping score, no quantity/experience multipliers, no mod effects). ON: mod rules apply at all three festivals, and festival scores scale with the quantity multiplier (e.g. difficulty 10 → 10 points per catch).
config.quantityIncome.name: Catch quantity income
config.quantityIncome.tooltip: Scales all caught fish quantities. Default 100%; allowed range 10%-300% (values outside are clamped). Applied to the final stack (after wild/challenge bait, difficulty-level quantity multiplier and star discounts, rounded up, at least 1 fish per catch); crab pots scale before the native 'Crabbing' book doubles; daily-limit zeroing still wins; inactive in vanilla-festival mode. Between anchors values transition smoothly around the linear expectation: only the sub-one-fish remainder resolves probabilistically (e.g. between Lv.0=1 and Lv.8=2, Lv.4 expects 1.5 -> about a 50% chance of 2); anchor levels and whole-number expectations are constant. Current anchor array below (actual anchors apply):
config.experienceIncome.name: Fishing experience income
config.experienceIncome.tooltip: Scales settled fishing experience. Default 100%; allowed range 10%-300%. Applied after base recalculation and the difficulty-level XP multiplier (rounded up); daily-limit zeroing takes priority; inactive in vanilla-festival mode and for crab pot's flat experience.
config.noMinigameQuantityIncome.name: No-minigame catch income
config.noMinigameQuantityIncome.tooltip: Scales quantities of no-minigame catches (rod-caught trash/algae and crab pot harvests). Default 100%; allowed range 10%-300%. Uses its own quantity curve (anchors below), independent of the other income sliders; applied before the native 'Crabbing' book doubles, rounded up, at least 1 per harvest. Leveling for these items is also probabilistic: each harvest requests +1 level but only a 5% chance to actually gain it.
